patches.title: Pre-Transformation Inventory Check
patches.principle: Before moving to a transformation site (sink, microwave, stove), verify you are holding the target object. If not, continue searching surfaces.
patches.when_to_apply: When you have not yet acquired the target object but are considering moving to a transformation location.

patches.title: Skip Non-Storage Furniture
patches.principle: During object search, only visit open surfaces (countertops, dining tables, shelves) and containers (cabinets, drawers). Ignore stoves, bathtubs, sinks unless task requires transformation.
patches.when_to_apply: When searching for an object and encountering non-storage furniture.

patches.title: Fixed Surface Order
patches.principle: Start search on countertop 1, then countertop 2, then diningtable, then shelf, before opening any containers. This order yields targets efficiently.
patches.when_to_apply: When beginning a cleaning task with no prior knowledge of object location.
